name: The Westin Dragonara Resort, Malta
insider_take: Perched on the prestigious Dragonara Peninsula, this resort sits on Malta's most exclusive piece of real estate - a private promontory surrounded by the crystal-clear Mediterranean on three sides.
whats_special: The hotel occupies the former grounds of the Dragonara Palace, built in 1870 as a summer residence for Marquis Scicluna. The resort features Malta's only casino housed within this historic palazzo, and boasts the island's largest outdoor pool complex. Its unique location means you're technically on a peninsula that was once completely separate from the mainland.
pro_tip: Book a sea-facing room on the upper floors for unobstructed 180-degree Mediterranean views - you'll watch both sunrise and sunset over different stretches of coastline from your balcony.
dont_miss: The underground Roman ruins discovered during the hotel's construction, visible through glass panels in the lobby. Take the scenic coastal walk around the entire peninsula (just 15 minutes) for Instagram-worthy shots, and visit the elegant Dragonara Casino - Malta's premier gaming destination housed in a 19th-century palace.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Dragonara Point peninsula
Multiple dining options including Mediterranean and Asian cuisine
Comprehensive wellness facilities with spa and fitness center
Easy access to St. Julians nightlife and Paceville district
cons: Can be busy during peak summer season
Higher price point for Malta accommodation standards
